consumerRule: Only a 404 ASSET_NOT_FOUND from Assets maps to UNRESOLVED. Any other failure of the lookup (a 500, a timeout, the service being down, or a 400 for a malformed id) is a lookup failure: the consumer shows an error entry with a null asset and never shows UNRESOLVED, so an outage cannot pass for a dataset of missing assets.

limitations: Synthetic lab content: no claim of canon.
Kinds, statuses and parents of the nine Missions-referenced assets are decided by this dataset; Missions holds ids only.
No timing judgment: DESTROYED and MISSING assets resolve with their status.
No location, no Personnel mapping and no cross-service rule beyond the references shown.
